canonical_project: Uttar Pradesh planned data center cluster / AI City - Lucknow
owner: Multiple prospective investors / Government of Uttar Pradesh (Tata Group dialogue)
notes: ETDatacenters (Jun 2026) reports UP has approved ~Rs 21,343 crore of data center investment proposals distributed across Noida, Yamuna Expressway Region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut and Sitapur with 644 MW committed capacity; CM Yogi (May 2026) directed officials to start dialogue with major companies including the Tata Group to develop Lucknow as an 'AI City'.
